hypothesis: After 8x MSAA, flatten only the bridge's periodic LED fixture phase at its exact period mean, retaining the edge envelope, tint, current antialias width and continuous light. A reduction attributes shimmer to the periodic fixture pattern. This is a diagnostic: spatial visibility weighting and view-dependent antialias width can still change the image mean.

provenance.note: Integrate 1-smoothstep(lower, upper, abs(fract(u)-0.5)) over one period. The clipped cubic antiderivative remains valid when the widening transition extends beyond half a period. Do not use a fixed 0.068 duty cycle: the shipped width depends on fwidth.
